flags: Platform BIS HL L2 (track 2): laser gives 0.86 m above the track bed (≈0.68 m above rail after −0.15…0.2 m), register class korkea = 0.55 m. Not decided; add to REVIEW.md.
OSM bridge outlines at the platforms that carry roads, tram or service ways, kept as kind 'bridge' (not footbridges): w786496613 Viipurintien ylikulkusilta (cycleway, footway, primary).
Laser-traced roof (113 m², top 4.3 m above the platform, 5.1 m above the track bed) lies partly over a track: it may be a train (a double-deck X40 is ~4.6 m tall), check in a cross-section.

profile.brief: the Sweden brief, applied to Finland (sources swapped for the Finnish equivalents)
profile.laser_line: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_M4131C2), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned M4131C2 2023-06-09 (20230207_Swissphoto_Riihimaki_kesa)
profile.box_note: : the platforms' extent plus a margin
profile.dtm_what: Ground, 1 m, float32, EPSG:3067, N2000, gridded here from the laser's ground points (class 2), median per 1 m cell; cells with no ground point (under buildings, trains, roofs) are no-data
profile.dtm_licence: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_M4131C2), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned M4131C2 2023-06-09 (20230207_Swissphoto_Riihimaki_kesa)
profile.ground_how: ground grid from the laser class 2 (see the GeoTIFF tags)
profile.register_what: Digitraffic infra-api platform objects (laiturit) as track-centre lines, with platform number, height class, length and the laser levels
profile.register_text: Register: Digitraffic infra-api `laiturit` (read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0): platform number (`kaupallinenNumero`), height class `korkea`/`matala`, length; no width or roof. Class heights: korkea 0.55 m, matala 0.265 m above rail (Väylävirasto Network Statement 2021 appendix 3B via Wikipedia "Platform height", read 2026-10-30).
